evals.prompt: Commit my changes. Split them into logical commits if needed.
evals.expected_output: Skill auto-triggers, inspects current git status and diffs, proposes logical commit groupings, and waits for approval before staging or committing.

expectations.name: skill-invoked
expectations.description: git-commit loads for a request to commit current work
expectations.check: Transcript shows the git-commit skill loaded

expectations.name: plans-before-commit
expectations.description: Presents a commit plan and asks for confirmation before git add or git commit
expectations.check: Transcript shows a commit plan before any staging or commit command

evals.prompt: Organize the staged and unstaged changes into [why]/[how] commits.
evals.expected_output: Skill auto-triggers, groups staged and unstaged changes by logical purpose, drafts commit messages with [why] and [how] sections, and waits for approval.

expectations.name: skill-invoked
expectations.check: Transcript shows the git-commit skill loaded

expectations.name: uses-why-how
expectations.description: Drafts commit messages with [why] and [how] sections
expectations.check: Output contains [why] and [how] commit body sections

evals.prompt: Squash the last five commits and reword them before I open the PR.
evals.expected_output: git-commit does not trigger because the request is about rewriting existing branch history. The rewrite-commits skill should handle it instead.

expectations.name: skill-not-invoked
expectations.description: git-commit does not load for existing commit history cleanup
expectations.check: Transcript does not show the git-commit skill loaded

evals.prompt: Create a pull request for this branch and include the test plan.
evals.expected_output: git-commit does not trigger because the request is a GitHub PR operation, not local commit creation.

expectations.name: skill-not-invoked
expectations.description: git-commit does not load for PR creation
expectations.check: Transcript does not show the git-commit skill loaded

evals.prompt: Check why CI failed on my PR.
evals.expected_output: git-commit does not trigger because the request is about remote GitHub CI status, not current local uncommitted changes.

expectations.name: skill-not-invoked
expectations.description: git-commit does not load for remote CI checks
expectations.check: Transcript does not show the git-commit skill loaded
